fontMetadata.successorNotes: A best-fit substitution rather than a design successor. Sonata is an Adobe font with no SMuFL migration path; Pmusic, which derives from it, names the same substitute. No glyph mappings are available for this font: the record exists so that a client substituting a modern face can still resolve a successor.
fontMetadata.sizeNotes: Recorded from prior knowledge, not measured: Sonata sized the same way as Pmusic, which measures 4.0. The font is an Adobe Type 1 face that does not run on current macOS, so it could not be verified here.
fontMetadata.provenanceNotes: Compiled for this project; no conversion data for this font is distributed with Finale. No glyph mappings are recorded, so the file carries font-level facts only.
